name: starktensor
title: Starktensor · red-team prompt bridge
description: A red-team / robustness-evaluation bridge between the elder-plinius 'pliny' prompt corpus and the agent protocol. It reads the adversarial jailbreak/liberation prompts the plinyville module already mirrors (DEFANGED, as a security exhibit) and exposes them to orbit/agent as labelled TEST overlays, so you can run your own agents against them and measure how well their guardrails hold. This is an evaluation harness, not a production guardrail-bypass switch: overlays are tagged redteam=true and are never auto-applied to a live agent. Sources are read from the local plinyville store, never re-scraped.
state: ~/.mod/starktensor/ (override with STARKTENSOR_DIR); the prompt corpus is read from the plinyville store (~/.mod/store/plinyville/mods)

endpoints.GET /health: Liveness probe (touches only the local store)
endpoints.POST /starktensor/info: What this module is and the routes it serves
endpoints.POST /starktensor/vendors: Red-team prompt source repos available in the local pliny corpus
endpoints.POST /starktensor/list: List prompt entries in one source repo (repo=, q=)
endpoints.POST /starktensor/get: Read one prompt's text, labelled RED-TEAM (repo=, path=)
endpoints.POST /starktensor/search: Grep the whole corpus for a string (q=)
endpoints.POST /starktensor/overlay: Build an agent-protocol RED-TEAM test overlay from a prompt (repo=, path=, agent=)
endpoints.POST /starktensor/probe: ROADMAP: run an agent against an overlay and score robustness

safety: The pliny corpus is guardrail-bypass (jailbreak) content. This module treats it the way plinyville does: as a DEFANGED red-team exhibit. Overlays are evaluation test-cases tagged redteam=true and are never silently mounted on a live agent.
